# Professional Laser Machines engineered for US Manufacturing

Trotec lasers for printers, manufacturing industry, engravers and schools. Based on over 25 years of
experience, we develop innovative comprehensive laser systems. Our laser machines, powerful software
and high-quality materials are perfectly matched.

### Speedy series

High-performance laser engraver and cutter.
[Speedy][155]

### E Line

All a Laser Cutter Needs. Focused on the essentials. Ready to grow with you.
[Discover E Line][156]

### SpeedMarker series

Automated laser marking machines for marking individual components as well as large batches.
[SpeedMarker][157]

### Laser software

Connected work, intuitive user interface, seamless workflow with laser software Ruby®.
[Discover laser software][158]

### Laser materials

Materials perfectly suited for processing with the laser. For high-quality results.
[Discover laser materials][159]

### Laser engraver

Ideal lasers for engraving and cutting an endless number of materials such as wood, acrylic and
plastic.
[Discover laser engraver][160]

### Laser cutter

Easy-to-use laser cutters for cutting acrylic, wood, textiles. From small to large format
applications.
[Discover laser cutter][161]

### Laser marker

Fiber lasers for permanent marking on metal and plastic. As stand-alone workstations or integrable
laser markers.
[Discover laser marker][162]

### Laser solutions

Integration lasers and cusomized laser marking solutions
[More info][163]
 


## Find the right laser for your business

Let's embark on this journey to discover the ideal product for you.

[Start product finder][164]

## Which material do you want to cut, engrave or mark?

Find the right [laser machine][165] for the material you need to process. We offer systems for a
wide range of materials and applications. Discover new possibilities for your success.

Acrylic Fabrics Glass Metal Paper Plastics Stone Wood

Crystal-clear edges: Perfect, crystal-clear edges without post-processing with a laser cutter for
acrylic.

[Laser cutter for acrylic][166]

Precise textiles cutting: Laser for engraving and cutting cotton, linen, silk, felt, denim or
polyester.

[Laser cutter for fabrics][167]

Glass engraving to perfection: Impressively fine and cost-effective engravings on glass.

[Laser engraver for glass][168]

Metallic resistance: Laser marking machine for permanent marking of components and data plates.

[Laser marker for metal][169]

Precise paper processing: Laser cutting and engraving fine paper, art paper, uncoated paper and
handmade paper. Laser cutter for scoring and perforating of high-quality invitations, business
cards, packaging, flyers or brochures.

[Laser cutter for paper][170]

Permanent markings, precise cuts: Permanent laser marking of serial numbers, precise cuts of plastic
components.

[Laser marker for plastics][171]

Stone finishing: laser engraving for the refinement and personalization of granite, marble or
ceramics.

[Laser engraver for stone][172]

Wood at its best: laser cutter for precise engraving and cutting of solid wood, MDF, plywood.

[Laser cutter for wood][173]

Adherex works with OEMs to create specialty materials that endure heat, vibration, sterilization,

and rigorously tested to ensure reliable performance under pressure.

**Meeting the Demands of OEMs.** In OEM markets, even a minor material failure can have major
consequences. A weak adhesive, miscut foam, or inconsistent packaging can halt production, trigger
costly recalls, or threaten regulatory compliance. These industries demand solutions built for
precision, consistency, and durability.

Combining engineering expertise with advanced processes like water jet and rotary die-cutting, we
help OEMs overcome design limits and scale seamlessly from prototype to production.

inserts, corrugated plastic dividers, or custom totes with dunnage, each solution balances
durability, cost, and efficiency.

[Prevent These Common Industrial Die Cutting Mistakes][141]

Industrial die cutting demands high precision, yet mistakes like incomplete cuts, rough edges, and
improper creasing frequently cause costly waste and assembly delays. To prevent these errors,
manufacturers must perform proactive test cuts on challenging soft or thick materials, select the
right pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs) paired with tear-resistant film liners, and balance design
tolerances to match material flexibility. Furthermore, regular preventive equipment
maintenance—including blade sharpening and alignment calibration—combined with modern automation
tools ensures consistent pressure, drastically minimizing defects while driving efficient,
sustainable, and high-quality production runs.

17 June 2026
[ ][142]
[Flatbed Vs. Rotary Die Cutting Machine: Which Suits Your Needs Better?][143]

Flatbed die cutting machines utilize a vertical press stroke to stamp stationary substrates, making
them highly efficient and cost-effective for cutting thick, dense materials in small-to-medium
production runs. While offering lower tooling costs and excellent material utilization compared to
high-speed rotary die cutters, they feature slower speeds and limited multi-functionality.

[Prevent These Common Industrial Die Cutting Mistakes][141]

Industrial die cutting demands high precision, yet mistakes like incomplete cuts, rough edges, and
improper creasing frequently cause costly waste and assembly delays. To prevent these errors,
manufacturers must perform proactive test cuts on challenging soft or thick materials, select the
right pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs) paired with tear-resistant film liners, and balance design
tolerances to match material flexibility. Furthermore, regular preventive equipment
maintenance—including blade sharpening and alignment calibration—combined with modern automation
tools ensures consistent pressure, drastically minimizing defects while driving efficient,
sustainable, and high-quality production runs.

17 June 2026
[ ][142]
[Flatbed Vs. Rotary Die Cutting Machine: Which Suits Your Needs Better?][143]

Flatbed die cutting machines utilize a vertical press stroke to stamp stationary substrates, making
them highly efficient and cost-effective for cutting thick, dense materials in small-to-medium
production runs. While offering lower tooling costs and excellent material utilization compared to
high-speed rotary die cutters, they feature slower speeds and limited multi-functionality.

A choice of offline digital die-cutting and kiss-cutting equipment for a wide range of applications
from packaging to Point of Sale & labels. Flatbeds and auto-feed cutting systems, dedicated
sheet-fed kiss-cut label cutting equipment, and Roll to roll cutter/finishers.

Discover how to add value to your print and increase profits.

Desktop and free-standing professional dual foiling and lamination machines, and  consumables offer
an affordable and on-demand in-house solution for adding metallic foils, laminates, and holographic
effects to your printed products.

equipment and consumables.

## **Güçlü Marka, Güvenilir Hizmet**

**KARADENİZ DIŞ TİCARET**, büro makineleri alanında güvenilir ve profesyonel çözümler sunan köklü
bir firmadır. 150.000’den fazla müşteriye ulaşmış ve %95 gibi yüksek oranda tekrarlanan sipariş
miktarına ulaşmıştır.

### Hitachi iH-110F 2 Pocket Banknote Sorter

iH-110 Series is reliable, precise and multi-functional sorter that provides a broad section of
options. It is an idea choice for bank branches, bank office in banks and cash-in-transit(CIT), as
well as casinos and retails.

##### High-speed Image processing technologies.

- Full color dual CIS sensor / Can be scanned 10 different images
- Capture and Record of OCR,MICR and Barcode / Deposit full color image
- Can be installed more than 40 currencies / Mix & Multi Currency mode


##### Advanced sensor technologies

- Equipped with a range of counterfeit detection technologies
- Reliable fitness sorting / Excellent tape detection performance User-friendly System
- 2 teller user mode indicator / Multi-user mode / Full color touch screen
- Easy operation, Simple maintenance Remote monitoring & management system
- Relate solution : Smart Integration Manager (SIM) [ Download PDF][111] [Ask for Quotation][112]

#### Scan Coin SC-8220

×

### Scan Coin SC-8220 1+1 Pocket Value & Multi Currency Counter

Latest Note Technology at the Competitive Price Reduce the manual cash handling and get full control
of your cash. Introducing the SC 8220, a high quality value and muti currency counter that delivers
outstanding result at low cost.
One set of currencies will be available for each main geographic region containing main
international currenciesand regional currencies.

##### Full Flexibility for the End User in Enriched User Interface.

Count and verify one currency with ease and accuracy as expected with SCAN COIN note unit, but when
it comes to handling multi-currency the new SC 8220 also proposes two new modes to avoid time
consuming and repetitive manipulations:
Multi: The machine accept different currencies in one single operation and provides a total note
count split into the various currencies found within the note bundle.
Auto: The machine identifies the currency of the first note in the bundle and sets itself in the
mode to count this currency and to reject all other currencies. As soon as the pockets are empty,
the machine turns back to the auto mode for the next notes acceptance. In this mode mixed notes of
many different currencies are counted without any keyboard operation.


##### Interration and Backward Compatibility

For easy back office integration SC 8220 is provided with its own protocol. All transactions can be
seen and managed using the free software.

##### Front Access Features

The SD card slot is placed on the front of the machine, thus making the update of the machine very
simple. If an SD card is let in the machine, the SD card will contain the list of all notes counted
or rejected, incuding serial numbers of the notes read.

##### UV LED Bar

A new patented UV LED bar placed under the machine will help manual authentication of bad notes. The
UV lights will turn on automatically for a few seconds when the notes are rejected.

#### Welcome to Southwest Binding & Laminating

We are your home for the best in presentation, binding, shrink wrapping, laminating supplies and
equipment. When you need to make information presentable speak to one of our professionals. We can
help you look your best when putting together your important presentation whether it is a sales
pitch, a classroom handout, corporate materials or even family photos. Our knowledgeable staff can
help you determine not only what you need but how to do it! For industry-specific needs click on the
applicable button to the right. For general information on how to laminate or choose the right
binding system explore our vast knowledge base with instructional videos, web pages and FAQs.

## **Booklet Makers** Specialist Range of Booklet Makers

We are proud to be a Partner of Duplo International and offer their full range of booklet makers for
both traditional and digital print production. Our booklet makers range, from small desktop machines
to fully automated digital and collator style feed engines offering up to 3,500 booklets per hour.

[View Our Booklet Makers][292]

## **Card Creasing Machines** The UK's Premier Card Creasing Specialists

A dedicated range of card creasing and perforating machines from entry level desktop manually
operated through to fully automated finishing machines capable of Slitting, Cutting, Creasing and
perforating in a single pass. Visit our showroom to see demonstrations of all our equipment.

[View our Card Creasing Machines][293]

## **Stapling & Stitching Machines** Systems for all budgets

A diverse range of Stapling and Stitching solutions from desktop devices capable of stapling up to
80 sheets through to heavy duty saddle stapling machines capable of stapling or stitching up to 270
sheets in a single pass. Stago, Rapid and IDEAL specialist.

[View Stapling Range][294]

## **Digital Folding Specialists** Buckle & Crease/Fold Solution Specialists

A wide range of dedicated digital folding solutions from Duplo, Eurofold and EasiCrease UK. From
traditional buckle fold technology incorporating the latest in vacuum feed technology to the very
latest from the evolving Touchline Family of Crease & Fold systems.

[View Digital Folding Solutions][295]

# Specialists in Print Finishing Equipment, Supplies & Consumables

**CUSTOMER CARE PACK** [More Info][296]
** ** [Print finishing supplies][297]

### **Welcome** to The Finishing Point

The home of printing consumables and new and used perfect binding machines, card creasing machines,
commercial laminating machines and much more!

## **Booklet Makers** Specialist Range of Booklet Makers

We are proud to be a Partner of Duplo International and offer their full range of booklet makers for
both traditional and digital print production. Our booklet makers range, from small desktop machines
to fully automated digital and collator style feed engines offering up to 3,500 booklets per hour.

[View Our Booklet Makers][292]

## **Card Creasing Machines** The UK's Premier Card Creasing Specialists

A dedicated range of card creasing and perforating machines from entry level desktop manually
operated through to fully automated finishing machines capable of Slitting, Cutting, Creasing and
perforating in a single pass. Visit our showroom to see demonstrations of all our equipment.

[View our Card Creasing Machines][293]

## **Stapling & Stitching Machines** Systems for all budgets

A diverse range of Stapling and Stitching solutions from desktop devices capable of stapling up to
80 sheets through to heavy duty saddle stapling machines capable of stapling or stitching up to 270
sheets in a single pass. Stago, Rapid and IDEAL specialist.

[View Stapling Range][294]

## **Digital Folding Specialists** Buckle & Crease/Fold Solution Specialists

A wide range of dedicated digital folding solutions from Duplo, Eurofold and EasiCrease UK. From
traditional buckle fold technology incorporating the latest in vacuum feed technology to the very
latest from the evolving Touchline Family of Crease & Fold systems.

[View Digital Folding Solutions][295]

# Specialists in Print Finishing Equipment, Supplies & Consumables

**CUSTOMER CARE PACK** [More Info][296]
** ** [Print finishing supplies][297]

### **Welcome** to The Finishing Point

The home of printing consumables and new and used perfect binding machines, card creasing machines,
commercial laminating machines and much more!

[The Finishing Point (TFP) Ltd]
